```{r}
require(tibble) # dataframe manipulation
require(readr) # for read_csv()
require(dplyr) # for mutate()
require(tidyr) # for unnest()
require(purrr) # for map(), reduce()
library(here) # for paths
```

# Read in mouse bulk metadata

```{r}
mouse_metadata <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_metadata_raw.rds"))

# Check
head(mouse_metadata)
```

```{r}
# Get the bioprojects from the mouse metadata
mouse_bioprojects <- unique(na.omit(mouse_metadata$bioproject))

# Mouse folders to check for count files
mouse_folders <- c("Mus_musculus", "Mus_musculus_other_cancers")

```

# Expression data

```{r}
# set directory for mammal data
base_dir <- "/orange/kgraim/panmammalian/data"
```


```{r}
# Function to find and read all bioproject .count files for mouse bioprojects in the metadata
find_and_read_gene_expression_files <- function(base_dir, mouse_folders, mouse_bioprojects) {
  # Lists to store files
  gene_expression_files <- list()
  count_data_list <- list()

  # Iterate through each mouse folder
  for (mammal in mouse_folders) {
    # construct the base path for the mammal
    mammal_path <- file.path(base_dir, mammal)

    # check if the mammal folder exists
    if (dir.exists(mammal_path)) {
      # get all bioproject folders in the mammal folder
      bioprojects <- list.dirs(mammal_path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  
      # only keep bioprojects that are in the mouse bulk metadata
      bioprojects <- bioprojects[basename(bioprojects) %in% mouse_bioprojects]
      
      # loop through each bioproject folder
      for (bioproject in bioprojects) {
        # look for 'paired' or 'single' layout folders
        layout_folders <- list.dirs(bioproject, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
        
        # filter for 'paired' and 'single' layout folders
        layout_folders <- layout_folders[grepl("paired|single", layout_folders)]
        
        # loop through each layout folder and look for the 'dexseq_count' folder for exp data
        for (layout_folder in layout_folders) {
          freya_results_path <- file.path(layout_folder, "freya_results", "dexseq_count")
          
          # check if the dexseq_count folder exists
          if (dir.exists(freya_results_path)) {
            # construct the path to the .count file
            count_file <- file.path(freya_results_path, paste0(basename(bioproject), ".count"))
            
            # if the .count file exists, add it to the list of file paths
            if (file.exists(count_file)) {
              gene_expression_files[[length(gene_expression_files) + 1]] <- count_file
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # read all .count files into a list of data frames
  for (count_file in gene_expression_files) {
    count_data <- read_tsv(count_file, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
    count_data_list[[length(count_data_list) + 1]] <- count_data
  }

  # return the list of file paths
  return(list(
    file_paths = gene_expression_files
  ))
}

result <- find_and_read_gene_expression_files(base_dir, mouse_folders, mouse_bioprojects)

file_paths <- result$file_paths

```

```{r}
# Save the file path list incase of anything
saveRDS(file_paths, file=here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_file_paths.rds"))

file_paths <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_file_paths.rds"))
```


```{r}
# load count files and drop the last 5 rows
species_expr <- lapply(file_paths, function(file) {
  data <- readr::read_tsv(file)
  head(data, -5)
})
```

```{r}
# Output species_expr incase of anything
saveRDS(species_expr, file=here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_species_expr_dfs.rds"))
```

```{r}
species_expr <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_species_expr_dfs.rds"))
```


# Clean exp files before joining:

```{r}
# Clean each mouse bioproject before joining
species_expr_clean <- lapply(species_expr, function(data) {
  data %>%
    
    # drop rows with NA in the "Genes" column only
    filter(!is.na(Genes)) %>%
    
    # get the gene, change gene name to upper case, remove any +- and keep everything after the 2nd underscore
    mutate(Genes = toupper(gsub("[+-]", "", sub("^[^_]*_[^_]*_(.*)", "\\1", Genes)))) %>%
    
    # remove duplicates by taking median
    dplyr::group_by(Genes) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), median, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop")
})
```

```{r}
# Output species_expr_clean incase of anything
saveRDS(species_expr_clean, file=here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_species_expr_clean.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Read in species_expr_clean
species_expr_clean <- readRDS(here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_species_expr_clean.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Check to make sure all duplicates are gone
has_duplicates <- sapply(species_expr_clean, function(x) {
  anyDuplicated(x$Genes) > 0
})

table(has_duplicates)
```

```{r}
# join the mouse count files
mouse_exp <- purrr::reduce(species_expr_clean, inner_join, by = "Genes")
```

```{r}
# Output mouse bulk exp combined incase of anything
saveRDS(mouse_exp, file=here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_exp_combined_raw.rds"))
```

### There are duplicate samples (between Mus_musculus and Mus_musculus_other_cancers), so when the data is joined, it renames the samples as sample1.x and sample1.y
```{r}
# Check if any samples (cols) end in '.x' or '.y'
any(grepl("\\.(x|y)$", names(mouse_exp)))

```

```{r}
# Drop all cols that end with .y
mouse_exp <- mouse_exp %>%
  dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y"))

# Replace ".x" at the end of col names with nothing
colnames(mouse_exp) <- gsub("\\.x$", "", colnames(mouse_exp))

```

```{r}
# Check if any samples (cols) end in '.x' or '.y'
any(grepl("\\.(x|y)$", names(mouse_exp)))

# Check if any duplicate samples (cols)
any(duplicated(names(mouse_exp)))
```

```{r}
# Save mouse exp data
saveRDS(mouse_exp, file=here("output_data/mouse_data/mouse_bulk_exp_clean.rds"))
```
